q1.a: Yes, completely free. We use free tiers of Vercel and Pusher.

q2.a: Up to 100 simultaneously (Pusher limit). For larger events, contact us.

q3.a: No! Guests play instantly via QR code. Sign in with Google/Yandex only for saving history and settings.

q4.a: Character names follow standard translations for each language.

q5.a: The game is for all Protestant churches. Questions are based on canonical Bible text.

q6.q: Can this be used with children?
q6.a: Yes! Content is safe for all ages. Easy level works great for Sunday school.
